data.name: Turrit MxGram
data.subtitle: MxGram-tweaked Turrit client (unofficial build)
data.localizedDescription: Turrit MxGram is the third-party Turrit messenger with the MxGram tweak (by m1ronx1412) injected: ghost mode with per-user exceptions, anti-revoke, saving of protected media and more, on top of the Turrit Telegram client.

compatibility.notes: UNOFFICIAL BUILD - TWICE OVER. Turrit is itself an unofficial third-party Telegram client (not affiliated with Telegram FZ-LLC), and this is a community rebuild of it with the MxGram tweak injected. The tweak's official project (m1ronx1412/mxgram) publishes .deb/.dylib assets only; the ready-to-sideload IPA exists solely in the IPA Vault source, so no developer-published IPA link exists to verify. Uses its own bundle identifier.
